subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

Megha’s habit of procrastination puts her colleagues __on lot of trouble__.
solution:
The correct answer is **'to a lot of trouble'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'to a lot of trouble'** should be used instead of **'on lot of trouble'.**
 
• **'Put to a lot of trouble'** is **a phrasal verb.** 
 
• It means 'to make extra work or cause problems for someone'.
 
 
• *Example: Her consistent bad behavior put Mukul **to a lot of trouble.***
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.****
 

Correct Sentence:__** *Megha's habit of procrastination puts her colleagues **to a lot of trouble.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहाँ **'on lot of trouble' **के स्थान पर **'to a lot of trouble'** का प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
 
• **'Put to a lot of trouble'** एक** phrasal verb** है।
 
• इसका अर्थ है 'अतिरिक्त काम करना या किसी के लिए समस्या पैदा करना'।
 
 
• *Example: Her consistent bad behavior put Mukul **to a lot of trouble.***
 
 
 
• अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 1** है।
